focus_area: Agent goal alignment and manipulation prevention
aws_service: AWS Step Functions / Amazon SNS / Amazon SES / Amazon S3 / Amazon CloudWatch
guidance: Routing every agent action through human review produces rubber-stamp approvals. Routing none produces unbounded autonomy. Risk-tiered approval pauses agents only for the decisions where human judgment actually changes the outcome, with enough context to make those decisions meaningful.
how_to_check: • You pause high-risk agent operations for human review before execution, and reviewers receive enough context to make informed decisions within a defined time window. • Escalation paths handle cases where primary reviewers are unavailable. • You log human approval decisions with timestamps and reviewer identities, creating an auditable record of human oversight for compliance purposes. For more information, see the AGENTSEC04-BP02 documentation.
